DESIGN. New `await-ci` park node (type `ci_check`) after `tdd-round`. A park dispatches no Agent CR, so waiting costs nothing.

WHY A NEW STATION TYPE, NOT A SECOND pr_review NODE. Four call sites key on the node TYPE. The decisive one is decideMarkReady (spec-pr.ts), which flips a PR out of draft when the DESTINATION node type is pr_review — a pr_review round-wait would un-draft after round one and start code review on unfinished work. Also keyed on type: loop-run-closed.ts, backlog-ticket.ts, the stations registry test, the web-ui HUMAN_STATIONS mirror.

THE [skip ci] TRAP (load-bearing). This repo's pr-checks format job auto-commits `style: prettier [skip ci]` to the PR branch. Once pods stop formatting, that commit lands on nearly every push, GitHub creates no checks for it, and ciConclusion(head) returns "none" forever. So verdicts read ciJudgedSha = newest commit carrying no skip-CI marker, not the head. Applied to the end-of-line await-pr wait too.

FEEDBACK CHANNEL. pr-ready-check reports {ci_feedback_sha, ci_failed_checks, ci_failure_summary} in resume args; resume-event-handler merges args BEFORE the walk advances; withCiFeedback appends a prompt block. It renders only when the incoming visit is changes_requested, because args persist after being acted on.

WIRING GOTCHA. The prompt is resolved in resolveNodeDispatch, called from advance-line.ts dispatchForNode — NOT in nodeLaunchSpec. Passing ciFeedback to the latter was silently dead. Unit tests stayed green; the implementation-loop acceptance harness caught it, which is exactly the composition layer it exists for.

PROMPTS. Format-step instruction removed from all seven delivering recipes. tdd-round runs only the acceptance tests plus the one test it writes. pr-ready re-runs nothing. fix-ci is handed failed check NAMES instead of reproducing install/lint/typecheck/build/test. Production runs lore.agent_definitions rows, so migration 0067 rewrites the seven org prompts conditionally and emits a catalog event each; catalog-seed.yaml regenerated.

TRADE-OFF. Pod minutes fall; GitHub Actions minutes rise (one PR-checks run per round, ~20 jobs); wall-clock per ticket grows by one CI run plus up to the 2-minute sweep interval. No pre-merge baseline of station_runs durations was captured.

REVIEW. Five bot findings across the stack. Four declined with reasons: masking lore/ checks inside the shared ciConclusion would break auto-merge and the end-of-line review-in-flight guard (the masking belongs only in the per-round verdict); octokit types check_run.output as required, so a null guard is dead code the no-unnecessary-condition rule rejects. One acted on: the truncation cap in withCiFeedback was kept and pinned by a test, since it guards the boundary where resume-event args become a prompt.

PROCESS. Inserting one test shifted spec anchors repo-wide; re-anchor by mapping the enclosing test TITLE through a git base ref, never by offset, and never twice over the same links. `npx eslint .` OOMs and {"answer": "I couldn't find one definitive list, so this is partial. Lore's memory says the auto-merge and await-pr statuses are held on unresolved review threads (`unresolved_threads`). That is the clearest direct cause I found.

Other things also keep it waiting:
- Auto-merge now only decides ready or wait (`decideMergeReady`). It no longer fixes anything. It stays in wait while a loop PR is behind main, conflicting or red. The implementation loop repairs and rebases those PRs. A person's PR is left for that person.
- Older notes list the gates for auto-merge as green CI, an APPROVED review from the bot, changed paths that all match the allowlist (specs/**, adrs/**, *.md, CLAUDE.md, .claude/**), and repo trust above a minimum threshold. If one isn't met, it doesn't approve. These notes may be out of date.
- CI is judged on the newest commit that doesn't carry a [skip ci] marker. Checks that are pending or missing on that commit keep it waiting.
- A PR whose auto-merge run already settled on its current head commit stays armed or parked until a new commit is pushed.
- If the loop was switched off before approval, it stops with the message 'the auto-merge loop was switched off before the pull request was approved' (`LOOP_OFF` in approve-merge.ts).", "sources": ["session:re-cinq/lore episode: 'The await-pr and auto-merge statuses are held on unresolved_threads.'", "session-summary/2026-10-23-loop-pr-upkeep-auto-merge-no-fixer (PR re-cinq/lore#3376)", "session-summary/2026-09-09-ci-judged-implementation-loop (PRs #1905, #1909, #1911)", "manual:re-cinq/lore#307,#308,#310,#311,#312,#313", "session:re-cinq/lore episode: settled auto-merge run stays armed or parked until a new commit", "apps/stations/src/auto-merge/approve-merge/approve-merge.ts"]}
